name: The weather
description: The day, and what it turns into by nightfall. Weighted toward ordinary.

tables.name: The weather
tables.description: Roll it at the start of a travelling day.

entries.body: Clear and cool. Good walking.
Overcast, with a wind that finds every gap in a cloak.
Drizzle that never quite becomes rain and never quite stops.
Warm and close. Flies. Tempers.
Fog until midday, thick enough to lose the road.
Bright and hot. Water runs short by afternoon.
Rain, proper rain, with the road turning to soup.
A cold snap. Frost on the grass at noon.
Wind from the sea, salt on everything, gulls inland.
A storm building all day on the horizon and never arriving.
Hail, briefly and hard.
Snow, out of season, and nobody can explain it.
A red sky all day. Animals uneasy. Old people crossing themselves.

tables.name: The weather: by nightfall
tables.description: What it does once the party stops.

entries.body: By nightfall: still and clear, and cold with it.
By nightfall: cloud comes over and the dark is total.
By nightfall: rain on the tent, steady, all night.
By nightfall: the wind gets up and stays up.
By nightfall: a warm night, and nobody sleeps well.
By nightfall: mist off the ground, knee deep.
By nightfall: lightning far off, no thunder.
By nightfall: a hard frost, and the water skin freezes.
By nightfall: the sky clears and there are more stars than there should be.
By nightfall: something in the weather changes that nobody can name.
